fixes: EditorPanel exposes aria-busy and makes its editor body inert during validation/save; Input, Select search/options and Cascader explicitly receive pending disabled state.
CascaderEditor reads current option props through computed refs, so changing pending/disabled/readonly updates its controller and search input.

Generic inline field controls retain exactly one owner of Form event notifications; nested controls and overlay drafts remain isolated. This fixes missing Textarea and InputNumber inline validation notifications.
New Form demos provide success, failure, reset, disabled and readonly save scenarios using a cancellable 1.2 second local timer. No remote service is used.
Unified design specification now states the pending editing/closing and reset behavior explicitly.
Corrected a Select test listener type in Maple presentation-search-ownership.spec.ts to accept the public value union.

stateCoverage: Input, Textarea, Select, Cascader in Cedar popover/dialog and Maple popup/dialog.
Pending blocks editing, cancel and duplicate confirmation; returning false preserves draft and permits successful retry.
Candidate validation failure leaves committed model unchanged and retains the editing session; correction can commit.
Reset an unrelated field leaves the editor active. Matching-field reset, whole-form reset and native reset close the editor and reject late validation/save completion.
disabled/readonly/read becoming effective aborts old save; restoring editability does not reopen the old draft.
Form disabled/readonly inheritance and explicit false field override preserve existing precedence.
